items.title: 遠東集團跨產業整合 亞泥攜手子公司打造低碳智慧建築方案
items.title_en: Far East Group Cross‑Industry Integration: Asia Cement Teams with Subsidiaries to Create Low‑Carbon Smart Building Solutions
paras: 亞泥(1102-TW)聯合旗下亞東預拌、亞利預鑄，並結合遠傳電信(4904-TW)，首次參展「2026 Build for NextGen國際永續智慧建築暨智慧建材展」，透過遠東集團跨產業整合，打造低碳智慧建築方案。
此次遠東集團展區以亞泥低碳材料為起點，串聯亞東預拌低碳混凝土、亞利預鑄工業化營造，再結合遠傳智慧建築營運方案，展現遠東集團跨產業整合能力，開展首日，遠東集團創新長徐國安出席參觀展區。
徐國安表示，「創新就是遠東精神」，面對產業與環境快速變化，集團持續整合各事業體的專業與技術，將創新轉化為實際應用，為建築產業的永續與未來發展注入新動能。
亞泥首次參與智慧建築展，以「從材料到營運」為核心，串聯旗下事業體的低碳材料、智慧製造與工程應用，亞泥持續投入製程減碳及低碳產品開發，推出「卜特蘭石灰石水泥」、「墁砌水泥」等產品，並完成所有產品類型碳足跡查證，同時通過SBTi 1.5°C減碳目標審查及CDP氣候變遷與供應商議合評比最高「A」級肯定。
亞東預拌運用低碳水泥材料，研發「LoopCon岡固低碳混凝土」，減碳幅度達30%至70%，並透過數位履歷提升品質與減碳透明度；亞利預鑄則以預鑄工法推動工廠製造、現場組裝，提升工程效率，將低碳材料延伸至營造應用。
此外，結合遠傳電信AI、AIoT、數位雙生及能源管理等技術，從材料、製造、營造一路延伸至建築營運，提升能源效率與營運效能，打造兼具未來性與永續性的智慧建築解方案。
paras_en: Asia Cement (1102‑TW) partnered with its subsidiaries Asia East Ready‑Mix and Asia Li Precast, and joined forces with Far EasTone Telecommunications (4904‑TW) to debut at the “2026 Build for NextGen International Sustainable Smart Building and Smart Materials Expo,” leveraging Far East Group’s cross‑industry integration to develop low‑carbon smart building solutions.

The Far East Group’s exhibition booth started with Asia Cement’s low‑carbon materials, linked them to Asia East Ready‑Mix’s low‑carbon concrete and Asia Li’s industrialized precast construction, and then integrated Far EasTone’s smart building operation solutions, showcasing the group’s cross‑industry capabilities. On the opening day, Far East’s innovation chief Hsu Kuo‑an attended the booth.

Hsu Kuo‑an said, “Innovation is the Far East spirit.” Facing rapid industry and environmental changes, the group continuously integrates the expertise and technology of its businesses, turning innovation into practical applications and injecting new momentum into the construction industry’s sustainability and future development.

Asia Cement’s first participation in a smart building expo centered on a “from material to operation” approach, connecting its low‑carbon materials, smart manufacturing and engineering applications. The company continues to invest in process carbon reduction and low‑carbon product development, launching products such as “Boteran limestone cement” and “Masonry cement,” completing carbon‑footprint verification for all product lines, and receiving approval for its SBTi 1.5°C reduction target as well as the highest “A” rating from CDP for climate change and supplier engagement.

Asia East Ready‑Mix uses low‑carbon cement to develop “LoopCon Kanggu Low‑Carbon Concrete,” achieving a carbon reduction of 30%‑70% and enhancing quality and carbon‑reduction transparency through digital traceability. Asia Li Precast promotes factory‑manufactured, on‑site assembled precast methods to improve construction efficiency and extend low‑carbon materials into building applications.

In addition, the solution incorporates Far EasTone’s AI, AIoT, digital twin and energy‑management technologies, extending from materials and manufacturing to construction and building operation, improving energy efficiency and operational performance to create smart building solutions that are both future‑ready and sustainable.

items.title: 友達集團智慧服務應用亮相半導體展 聚焦製造效率及能源韌性
items.title_en: AU Optronics Group Showcases Smart Service Applications at Semiconductor Expo, Focusing on Manufacturing Efficiency and Energy Resilience
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)積極推動AI四支箭布局，其中「AI產品應用與智慧服務」於SEMICON Taiwan展現成果，子公司宇沛永續聚焦半導體產業在製造效率、能源韌性與永續治理上的轉型需求，展現智慧服務如何協助企業兼顧成長與永續發展。
友達表示，隨著AI、高效能運算及先進封裝需求持續攀升，全球半導體產業迎來新一波成長浪潮，然而，在算力與產能快速擴張下，能源、水資源及碳管理挑戰也日益升高，製造效率、能源韌性及永續治理能力成為企業競爭力的關鍵分水嶺。
因應先進製程對高良率、高效率與自動化能力的需求，半導體產業普遍面臨製程穩定度、設備異常預警、產線稼動率及廠內物流效率等挑戰，宇沛永續透過智慧檢測AOI、智慧搬運AMR及智慧運營AIoT等技術，協助半導體廠串聯設備、製程與生產數據，提升製程穩定度與營運效率。
此外，AI資料中心與先進製程帶動電力需求攀升，能源管理已成為半導體產業維持產能與營運韌性的重要挑戰，宇沛永續整合智慧中樞、能源管理與ACA碳管理平台、ESCO節能服務及低碳能源布局，協助企業掌握耗能熱點、優化設備運轉並提升能源使用效率，建立高效率、高韌性的低碳營運模式。
隨著CBAM、碳揭露及供應鏈減碳要求升溫，企業面對的已不只是碳盤查，而是如何建立可持續的治理能力。宇沛永續結合氣候永續顧問、智慧水務工程、氨氮廢水回收及異味解決方案等服務，協助企業從水資源循環、環境管理到永續策略規劃，建立兼顧營運與永續的治理架構。
paras_en: Panel giant AU Optronics (2409‑TW) is actively advancing its AI “four‑arrow” strategy, with the “AI product applications and smart services” segment unveiling results at SEMICON Taiwan. Its subsidiary Yupi Sustainable focuses on the semiconductor industry's transformation needs in manufacturing efficiency, energy resilience, and sustainable governance, demonstrating how smart services can help companies balance growth with sustainability.

AU Optronics said that as demand for AI, high‑performance computing and advanced packaging continues to rise, the global semiconductor industry is entering a new wave of growth. However, rapid expansion of compute power and capacity also heightens challenges in energy, water and carbon management, making manufacturing efficiency, energy resilience and sustainable governance key competitive differentiators.

To meet advanced‑process demands for high yield, high efficiency and automation, the semiconductor sector commonly faces issues such as process stability, equipment anomaly alerts, line utilization and internal logistics efficiency. Yupi Sustainable leverages smart inspection AOI, smart transport AMR and smart operations AIoT technologies to link equipment, processes and production data, boosting process stability and operational efficiency.

Moreover, AI data centers and advanced processes drive up power demand, making energy management a critical challenge for maintaining capacity and operational resilience in the semiconductor industry. Yupi Sustainable integrates a smart hub, energy management and ACA carbon‑management platform, ESCO energy‑saving services and low‑carbon energy solutions to help firms identify energy‑hot spots, optimize equipment operation and improve energy‑use efficiency, establishing a high‑efficiency, high‑resilience low‑carbon operating model.

As CBAM, carbon disclosure and supply‑chain decarbonization requirements intensify, companies face not only carbon accounting but also the need to build sustainable governance capabilities. Yupi Sustainable combines climate‑sustainability consulting, smart water engineering, ammonia‑nitrogen wastewater recycling and odor‑control solutions to assist firms in water‑resource circulation, environmental management and sustainability strategy planning, creating a governance framework that balances operations with sustainability.

items.title: 記憶體缺貨難解 三星70%產能鎖定到2031年
items.title_en: Memory Shortage Persists as Samsung Locks 70% Capacity Until 2031
paras: 人工智慧（AI）建設熱潮引爆高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求，並排擠傳統DRAM供給、加劇記憶體缺貨。
據《首爾經濟日報》31日（周一）報導，三星記憶體業務部門已將2031年前約70%產能分配給長約訂單（long-term agreements，簡稱LTAs），主要簽約客戶包括輝達(NVDA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、Google等大型科技公司。
然而，就連這些大型科技公司都無法取得合約約定的全部供貨量，HBM搶貨情況相當激烈，帶動現貨價格進一步飆升。
記憶體市場研究公司MegaGrid Supply的數據顯示，一塊36GB HBM3E產品現貨售價為2,100美元，相當於長期合約價格的四到五倍。
目前正準備量產的16層HBM4產品，如果廠商通過現貨市場而非長期合約購買，交易價格高達3,500美元。
供應壓力正從HBM蔓延至一般DRAM。隨著廠商向輝達等大型科技客戶供應的HBM4持續增加，HBM生產吸收大量DRAM產能，進一步推升DRAM價格。
此外，仍處於量產初期的HBM4，生產良率低於上一代HBM3E，製造過程需要耗用更多DRAM，也使整體DRAM供應短缺進一步惡化。
目前三星電子和SK海力士認為記憶體短缺問題短期內無法解決，正從多個方面尋求產能擴張。
三星設備解決方案部門管理層正在評估，最快2027年開始將平澤園區晶圓代工產線S5轉為記憶體生產線。
另據業界人士透露，SK海力士在擴大龍仁和湖南地區的生產基地後，也考慮與日本夥伴建立合資工廠。業界人士關注的焦點是SK海力士可能會擴大與鎧俠（Kioxia）合作。
paras_en: The AI construction boom has spurred demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), displacing traditional DRAM supply and worsening memory shortages.

According to the Seoul Economic Daily on Monday the 31st, Samsung’s memory business has allocated about 70% of its capacity before 2031 to long‑term agreements (LTAs), with major customers including NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Google and other large tech firms.
Even these large tech companies cannot secure the full contracted supply, making HBM a highly competitive commodity and driving spot prices even higher.
MegaGrid Supply, a memory market research firm, reports that a 36GB HBM3E product is selling at $2,100 on the spot market, four to five times the long‑term contract price.
The 16‑layer HBM4 product that is currently being prepared for mass production can fetch up to $3,500 on the spot market if purchased outside of long‑term contracts.

Supply pressure is spreading from HBM to conventional DRAM. As manufacturers increase HBM4 supply to large tech customers like NVIDIA, HBM production consumes a large share of DRAM capacity, further pushing up DRAM prices.
Moreover, the early‑stage HBM4 has a lower yield than the previous HBM3E, requiring more DRAM in the manufacturing process, which further aggravates the overall DRAM supply shortage.
Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix both believe that the memory shortage cannot be solved in the short term and are seeking capacity expansion from multiple angles.
Samsung’s equipment solutions management is evaluating the possibility of converting the S5 wafer‑foundry line at the Pyeongtaek plant to a memory production line as early as 2027.

Industry sources also say that after expanding its production bases in Yongin and Hunan, SK Hynix is considering a joint venture with a Japanese partner, and there is particular interest in a potential expansion of its partnership with Kioxia.

items.title: 〈台新新光法說〉台新銀上修全年NIM展望 林維俊看好台下半年景氣動能無虞
items.title_en: Taishin Shin Kong Earnings Call: Taishin Bank Raises Full-Year NIM Outlook; Lin Wei‑jun Confident About Taiwan’s H2 Economic Momentum
paras: 台新新光金控(2887-TW)今(1)日召開法說會，針對台灣下半年景氣，總經理林維俊直言，在全球 AI 算力需求爆發、相關供應鏈訂單滿載下，「下半年景氣動能應該沒有問題」，儘管仍需留意中東地緣政治風險，但管理層對營運前景信心十足，並宣布上修台新銀行全年 NIM 展望，台新與新光 2 家銀行預定於 2027 年元旦正式合併。
台新新光金控上半年稅後純益438億元，年增329%，每股稅後純益(EPS)為1.69元，年化股東權益報酬率(ROE)衝上15.36%，每股淨值為26.28元。台新銀行與新光銀行上半年合計稅後純益達172億元，年增高達74.2%。其中，台新銀行上半年稅後純益124億元(年增26%)，創下歷史同期新高記錄；新光銀行則貢獻48億元。
台新銀行上半年淨利息收入達 200 億元，年增 26.7%；淨手續費收入 110 億元，年增32%，主要受惠於財富管理與信用卡業務動能強勁。截至上半年，台新銀行總放款規模已正式突破 2 兆元大關，年增 12%。
由於資金調度與業務營運效率優於預期，台新銀行總經理林淑真表示，經營團隊已將全年的淨利息收益率(NIM)展望，由原先預期的較去年增加4至5個基點，上修至增加5至8個基點。
至於市場關注的銀行合併作業，林維俊表示，台新銀行與新光銀行已於今年8月初正式取得主管機關核准函，整體工作皆依規劃穩健推進，並取得突破性進展。未來將以台新銀行為存續公司，合併基準日確定為2027年1月1日，團隊將全力確保整併平穩順暢，發揮集團最大綜效。
全球總經方面，林維俊分析，全球景氣正處於中東衝突引發的通膨疑慮與AI歷史性投資熱潮兩股力量的拉鋸中，IMF在7月最新展望中將2026年全球經濟成長率維持在3.0%，並調升了受惠於AI投資的台、日、韓等國。
林維俊認為，全球對AI服務與算力需求強勁且供給吃緊，從台灣AI供應鏈訂單滿載現況來看，「下半年景氣動能完全沒有問題」。主要的下行風險仍為中東衝突是否會導致石油與原物料價格上升，央行利率決策與金融市場亦將隨地緣政治發展動態變化。
台新證券受惠於台股指數走高及市場交投熱絡，上半年稅後純益達75億元。隨著營運據點在合併後擴張，台新證將透過獨特的共銷機制，結合銀行與人壽通路資源，強化市場覆蓋率。面對AI產業鏈動能，也將持續優化系統以提升獲利表現。
針對資本規劃，經營團隊指出，台新證券目前資本適足率維持在300%以上的健康水準，短期內無增資需求，未來將視長遠發展考量透過聯貸等多元融資管道規劃。
paras_en: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding (2887‑TW) held an earnings conference today, and General Manager Lin Wei‑jun said that with a global explosion in AI computing demand and a fully booked supply‑chain order book, “the economic momentum for the second half of the year should not be a problem.” While noting the need to watch Middle‑East geopolitical risks, management expressed strong confidence in operating prospects and announced an upward revision of Taishin Bank’s full‑year net interest margin (NIM) outlook. The two banks, Taishin and Shin Kong, plan to formally merge on New Year’s Day 2027.

Taishin Shin Kong reported a first‑half after‑tax net profit of NT$43.8 billion, up 329% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.69. The annualized return on equity (ROE) rose to 15.36% and book value per share reached NT$26.28. Taishin Bank and Shin Kong Bank together posted a first‑half after‑tax profit of NT$17.2 billion, a 74.2% increase. Taishin Bank’s first‑half profit was NT$12.4 billion, up 26% and a historic high for the period, while Shin Kong contributed NT$4.8 billion.

Taishin Bank’s first‑half net interest income reached NT$20 billion, up 26.7% year‑over‑year, and net fee income was NT$11 billion, up 32%, driven by strong wealth‑management and credit‑card businesses. By the end of the first half, the bank’s total loan portfolio officially broke the NT$2 trillion mark, a 12% year‑over‑year increase.

Because funding deployment and operational efficiency exceeded expectations, Taishin Bank General Manager Lin Shu‑chen said the management team has revised the full‑year net interest margin (NIM) outlook from an earlier expectation of a 4‑5 basis‑point increase over last year to a 5‑8 basis‑point increase.

Regarding the much‑watched bank merger, Lin Wei‑jun said Taishin Bank and Shin Kong Bank received official approval from regulators in early August this year. The integration work is proceeding steadily as planned and has achieved breakthrough progress. The merged entity will retain Taishin Bank as the surviving company, with the merger effective date set for January 1 2027. The team will work to ensure a smooth integration and maximize group synergies.

On the global macro front, Lin Wei‑jun noted that the world economy is caught between inflation concerns sparked by Middle‑East conflicts and a historic wave of AI investment. The IMF’s July outlook kept global growth at 3.0% for 2026 and upgraded growth forecasts for AI‑benefiting economies such as Taiwan, Japan and South Korea.

Lin Wei‑jun believes that strong global demand for AI services and computing power, coupled with tight supply, means “the economic momentum for the second half is completely fine” based on Taiwan’s fully booked AI supply‑chain orders. The main downside risks remain the potential for Middle‑East tensions to push up oil and commodity prices, as well as central‑bank rate decisions and financial‑market reactions to geopolitical developments.

Taishin Securities benefited from a rising Taiwan stock index and active market trading, posting a first‑half after‑tax profit of NT$7.5 billion. After the merger, the firm will expand its operating locations and, through a unique co‑distribution mechanism that leverages bank and life‑insurance channels, enhance market coverage. Facing AI‑industry momentum, it will continue to optimize its systems to improve profitability.

Regarding capital planning, the management team said Taishin Securities’ capital adequacy ratio remains healthy at over 300%, with no short‑term capital‑raising needs. Going forward, the firm will consider diversified financing options such as syndicated loans as part of its long‑term development strategy.

items.title: 出席投資歐盟論壇 賴清德：台灣期待與歐盟簽避免雙重課稅、投資保障協定
items.title_en: President Lai Qingde Attends EU Investment Forum, Expresses Taiwan's Anticipation to Sign Double Taxation and Investment Protection Agreement with the EU
paras: 總統賴清德今(1)日出席「2026投資歐盟論壇」時表示，台灣與歐洲經貿交流日益緊密，目前台灣企業赴歐投資布局亦更具規模，面對全球產業競爭及供應鏈重組，期待台歐整合半導體領域優勢，深化戰略夥伴關係，推動簽署協定及投資保障協議，未來共同打造更安全、多元且具韌性的全球供應鏈。
賴清德今日以英文致詞時表示，這些年來，台灣與歐洲的經貿交流越來越緊密，去(2025)年台歐盟雙邊貿易額達到近750億美元，使歐盟成為台灣第5大貿易夥伴，如果以10年為單位，過去10年台企赴歐盟國家的投資額也大幅成長650%。
賴清德強調，近期很高興看到，台灣區電電公會(TEEMA)已宣布在波蘭設立科技園區，未來將有助更多台灣企業在歐盟投資並與在地產業合作，這些成果反映台歐經貿關係的深度，也顯示出台灣企業已經從單一個案投資，逐步走向更加整合、長期且深具規模的歐洲布局。
賴清德也期待，台、歐能夠在全球科技發展中，有更多的交流合作。包括明(2)日SEMICON Taiwan 2026即將登場，此項展覽可讓全球半導體與科技指標企業共同探索AI晶片、先進封裝等領域的合作商機，包括當前世界各國都致力於強化自身產業實力，歐盟執委會在今年6月公布「歐洲晶片法2.0」草案，聚焦加速晶片商業化與進入市場的時程，也展現歐洲追求半導體產業競爭力以及提升供應鏈韌性的決心。
賴清德說，目前台灣與歐洲在半導體領域各有所長，台灣已經建立高度整合的產業生態系，而歐洲在研發、設備、材料，以及高附加價值製造等領域擁有世界級的實力，透過整合台歐雙方優勢，建立半導體戰略夥伴關係，將可以創造更大的共同價值，一起打造更安全、更多元、更具韌性的全球半導體生態系。
paras_en: President Lai Qingde attended the 2026 EU Investment Forum today and said that Taiwan's economic and trade exchanges with Europe are becoming increasingly close, and that Taiwanese companies are now investing in Europe on a larger scale. Facing global industrial competition and supply‑chain restructuring, he looks forward to Taiwan and the EU integrating their strengths in the semiconductor field, deepening strategic partnership, and signing agreements and investment protection accords to jointly build a safer, more diverse and resilient global supply chain.

During his speech in English, Lai noted that over the years Taiwan’s economic and trade exchanges with Europe have grown tighter, and that by 2025 the bilateral trade volume between Taiwan and the EU will reach nearly $75 billion, making the EU Taiwan’s fifth‑largest trading partner. Over the past decade, Taiwanese investment in EU countries has grown by 650%.

Lai highlighted his pleasure at seeing the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers Association (TEEMA) announce the establishment of a technology park in Poland, which will help more Taiwanese firms invest in the EU and collaborate with local industry. These achievements reflect the depth of Taiwan‑EU economic and trade relations and show that Taiwanese companies are moving from single‑case investments to more integrated, long‑term, and large‑scale European layouts.

He also expressed hope that Taiwan and the EU can engage in more exchanges and cooperation in global technology development. Tomorrow, SEMICON Taiwan 2026 will take place, providing a platform for global semiconductor and technology leaders to explore cooperation opportunities in AI chips, advanced packaging, and more. With countries worldwide striving to strengthen their industrial capabilities, the EU Commission announced the “European Chips Act 2.0” draft in June, focusing on accelerating chip commercialization and market entry, demonstrating Europe’s determination to enhance semiconductor competitiveness and supply‑chain resilience.

Lai said that Taiwan and Europe each have strengths in the semiconductor field: Taiwan has built a highly integrated industry ecosystem, while Europe excels in R&D, equipment, materials, and high‑value manufacturing. By integrating these strengths and establishing a semiconductor strategic partnership, they can create greater shared value and jointly build a safer, more diverse, and more resilient global semiconductor ecosystem.

items.title: AI賺翻獎金卻談不攏！美光台灣工會逾八成挺罷工 晶片供應鏈拉警報
paras: 美國記憶體大廠美光(MU-US)在台工會周二(9/1)表示，除非公司改革獎金制度，並將更多獲利分享給員工，否則將朝發動罷工的方向推進。工會內部調查顯示，逾八成參與會員支持罷工，若最終付諸行動，恐衝擊美光營運及台灣半導體供應鏈。
代表美光桃園及台中員工的工會在書面回覆《路透》時表示，美光在兩地約有1.5萬名員工，其中近1萬人為工會會員。工會8月進行的內部網路調查顯示，參與投票的會員中，超過80%支持採取罷工行動。
美光台灣回應稱，今年發放的績效獎金將創公司史上最高，並表示將在尊重相關法律程序的前提下，持續透過現有管道與員工溝通。

工會要求獲利共享 一次性獎金上看83個月薪資

工會主張，美光現行激勵薪酬計畫(Incentive Pay Plan，IPP)未能充分反映公司獲利能力，因此要求2026會計年度額外發放一次性獎金。依工會提出的方案，每名台灣員工可分得的金額約相當於83個月薪資。
自2027會計年度起，工會希望廢除現行IPP制度，改為提撥營業利益的15%作為員工獎金，並由每年發放一次改為按季發放。
美光現行IPP是依據公司整體及員工個人績效決定年度獎金。工會認為，美光未充分說明公司績效指標的計算方式，且該指標似乎更貼近營收成長，而非實際獲利。工會並稱，美光已表明今年獎金仍會沿用現行制度，同時延後相關協商。
美光則表示，公司薪酬架構不同於工會要求的獲利共享模式。員工報酬除基本薪資及年度績效獎金外，也包括營運獎金、員工持股計畫及限制型股票等股權方案。
工會指出，南韓三星電子及SK海力士(SKHY-US)的獲利共享制度，已進一步拉大美光台灣員工與南韓同業員工之間的待遇差距。三星電子今年5月便在最後一刻達成協議，取消原定由最多4.8萬名工會會員參與、為期18天的罷工，並設立相當於晶片部門營業利益10.5%的特別獎金池，但仍須符合獲利目標。

台灣為美光最大生產基地 罷工恐衝擊晶片供應鏈

這項罷工威脅正值人工智慧(AI)硬體帶動記憶體需求大增之際。全球供應日益吃緊，也推升記憶體業者獲利。美光是全球第三大記憶體晶片製造商，截至5月28日止的第三季營收創下414.6億美元紀錄，淨利達282.4億美元，周二市值約1.1兆美元。
台北官員指出，台灣是美光全球最大生產基地。美光累計在台投資1.4兆元，主要生產動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)及高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，因此罷工可能對公司營運造成嚴重干擾。
中部科學園區管理局上月表示，正密切關注勞資爭議，並已指派人員協助雙方聯繫。罷工除了影響員工生計及美光營運，也可能波及台灣半導體供應鏈及整體經濟，必要時可啟動勞資協商或調解。
總統賴清德周二表示，台灣半導體產業是透過專業分工及長期合作建立，台灣始終穩定供應全球市場並信守承諾。在台灣力圖鞏固全球可靠晶片生產中心地位之際，美光勞資爭議的後續發展備受關注。

items.title: 力麗郭紹儀連任紡拓會董事長 攜手業界共創新局
items.title_en: Guo Shaoyi Re-elected Chairman of the Textile Association, Partnering with Industry to Create New Opportunities
paras: 紡拓會今(1)日召開第18屆第1次董事會，會中推選由力麗(1444-TW)暨力鵬(1447-TW)董事長郭紹儀連任紡拓會董事長，副董事長則分別由代表上游、中游及下游紡織產業之蘇百煌、黃莊芳容及吳道昌擔任。
郭紹儀表示，再次連任除了感謝全體董事的鼎力支持，也深感責任重大，面對國際經貿環境變化、綠色淨零趨勢加速，以及國際品牌對快速、彈性供應鏈的需求日益提升，均為當前紡織產業必須積極面對的重要課題。
郭紹儀強調，將進一步整合上、中、下游產業鏈的力量，積極爭取政府支持，投入更多資源，帶領紡拓會持續深耕低碳永續、加速高值化研發、拓展全球市場布局，提升地緣風險應變能力，並掌握AI發展契機，為紡織產業注入創新動能，開創更具競爭力的發展新局。
紡拓會表示，過去三年來，全球經貿環境快速變動，面對地緣政治衝突、各國關稅政策調整、生產營運成本上升及國際市場競爭加劇等多重挑戰，國內紡織產業面臨前所未有的考驗。
紡拓會指出，郭紹儀於2023年9月至2026年任期期間，帶領紡拓會穩健應對國際局勢變化，持續推動產業升級轉型，並積極協助業者開拓市場、掌握新的發展契機，在變局中持續強化產業韌性與競爭力。
paras_en: The Textile Association held its 18th first board meeting today (1), during which Chairman Guo Shaoyi of Lili (1444‑TW) and Lipei (1447‑TW) was re-elected as chairman. Vice chairmen were appointed from the upstream, midstream and downstream textile sectors: Su Baihuang, Huang Zhuangfangrong and Wu Daochang.

Guo Shaoyi expressed that his re-election is thanks to the strong support of all directors, and he feels a great responsibility. He noted that the changing international trade environment, the accelerating green zero‑emission trend, and the growing demand from international brands for fast, flexible supply chains are key challenges that the textile industry must actively confront.

He emphasized that the association will further integrate upstream, midstream and downstream industry chains, actively seek government support, invest more resources, and lead the Textile Association to continue deepening low‑carbon sustainability, accelerate high‑value R&D, expand global market presence, enhance resilience to geopolitical risks, and seize opportunities in AI development to inject innovative momentum into the textile industry and create a more competitive future.

The association stated that over the past three years, the global economic and trade environment has changed rapidly. Facing geopolitical conflicts, tariff policy adjustments, rising production and operating costs, and intensified international market competition, the domestic textile industry has encountered unprecedented challenges.

It added that during Guo Shaoyi’s term from September 2023 to 2026, he has led the association to steadily respond to international changes, continue to promote industry upgrade and transformation, and actively help operators expand markets and seize new development opportunities, thereby continuously strengthening industry resilience and competitiveness amid changing circumstances.

items.title: 央行信用管制波及！土銀土建融降至4000億 土銀董座盼「鬆綁」這件事
items.title_en: Central Bank Credit Controls Impact! Land Bank's Construction Financing Drops to 400 Billion, Chairman Hopes for 'Lifting Restrictions'
paras: 土地銀行即將迎來80週年行慶，董事長何英明受訪時表示，預估今年（2026年）獲利將延續成長態勢，順利超越去年的200億元大關，再度刷新歷史紀錄。然而，身為100%持股的國營公股銀行，土銀不以追求高每股盈餘（EPS）或支撐股價為目標，而是將超額盈餘透過特別盈餘公積轉增資、充實資本結構，並將逾期放款比率控制在0.06%左右的極低水準，以深厚儲備應對未來經濟波動及長達40年期房貸帶來的結構性挑戰。何英明指出，建商目前最期盼的並非全面鬆綁，而是希望政府能在18個月動工期限的規定上給予適度彈性。

何英明指出，商業銀行多以180天期為主的商業融資為主，收息速度較快；但土銀作為不動產專業銀行，放款期程往往長達數十年，前五年甚至可能只還息不還本，每個月收回的本金較少。因此，土銀無法採取上市銀行的經營模式，而是必須在平時累積資本盈餘，並將特別盈餘公積陸續轉為股本（目前股本已達1000多億元），避免因單一年度上繳盈餘過多而影響流動性覆蓋率（LCR）與資本適足率（BIS）。這種「求人不如求己」的深積糧策略，讓土銀在面對經濟失業率變化或金融風暴時，依然保有高度強韌的資產品質。
回顧土銀的歷史使命，何英明強調，土銀長期扮演政府政策的開路先鋒。從早期的農地改革、發行10年期實物債券與公營事業股票撫平地主，到支援台中與新竹等地的工業區開發、乃至獨力出資興建石門水庫與寶二水庫等重大水利工程，土銀肩負了遠超過一般商業銀行的社會責任與政策任務。時至今日，面對政策性新青安貸款，土銀同樣承接大量庫存案件，目前已有許多既有申請案陸續撥款，最後撥款期限預計延伸至10月底。
談及當前房市與建融現況，何英明分析，受央行信用管制及建商態度轉趨觀望、買地意願降低影響，土銀的土建融餘額已從高點約4,800億至5,000億元，逐步遞減至目前的4,000多億元。雖然建商購地趨緩，但隨著先前建案陸續完工交屋，土建融已平穩轉化為分戶房貸，使土銀的房貸業務持續維持成長力道。
針對大型重劃區（如新北溫仔圳、台中大慶等）因都市計畫、土地分配或土方處理而導致開發期程延後的個案，何英明表示，若屬不可歸責於借款人的狀況，土銀會視個案實際情形協助辦理展延。同時，土銀針對單一重劃區訂有嚴格的風險控管標準，承作土地面積通常不超過該區總面積的20%，以有效防範擔保品集中度過高的風險。
展望整體房市政策，何英明預估短期內央行政策全面放寬的機率不高，市場資金緊張仍需時間消化。建商目前最期盼的並非全面鬆綁，而是希望政府能在18個月動工期限的規定上給予適度彈性與喘息空間，避免因強迫動工或土方運送受阻而衍生爛尾樓問題。土銀未來將持續秉持穩健經營原則，兼顧政策配合與風險控管，奠定永續營運基礎。
paras_en: Land Bank is about to celebrate its 80th anniversary. Chairman He Yingming said that the bank expects to continue its growth trend this year (2026), surpassing last year’s 20 billion yuan mark and setting a new record. As a 100% state‑owned public bank, Land Bank does not chase high EPS or support its share price; instead it converts excess earnings into a special reserve and increases capital, keeping overdue loan ratios around 0.06% to prepare for future economic swings and the structural challenges of 40‑year mortgages. He added that developers are not looking for a full easing of restrictions, but rather for some flexibility in the 18‑month construction start rule.

He explained that commercial banks mainly focus on 180‑day commercial financing with quick interest collection, whereas Land Bank, as a real‑estate specialist, offers loans that can last several decades, with the first five years sometimes interest‑only, resulting in lower monthly principal repayments. Therefore, Land Bank cannot adopt the operating model of listed banks; it must accumulate capital surpluses and gradually convert the special reserve into equity (the share capital is now over 100 billion yuan) to avoid excessive annual profit contributions that would affect liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) and capital adequacy ratio (BIS). This self‑reliant, deep‑buffer strategy keeps Land Bank’s asset quality robust against unemployment shifts or financial storms.

Reflecting on its historical mission, He emphasized that Land Bank has long been a pioneer of government policy. From early land reform, issuing 10‑year physical bonds and public‑utility stocks to appease landowners, to supporting industrial zone development in Taichung and Hsinchu, and even single‑handedly funding major water projects like Shimen and Bao‑Er reservoirs, Land Bank has shouldered responsibilities far beyond a typical commercial bank. Today, facing new policy‑driven green loans, it continues to take on large inventory cases, with many existing applications already disbursed and final disbursement dates expected to extend to the end of October.

Regarding the current housing market and construction financing, He noted that due to central bank credit controls and developers’ cautious stance, Land Bank’s construction‑financing balance has fallen from a peak of about 480–500 billion yuan to just over 400 billion yuan. Although developers’ land purchases have slowed, completed projects are steadily converting construction loans into individual mortgages, allowing Land Bank’s mortgage business to maintain growth momentum.

For large redevelopment areas (such as New Taipei’s Wen‑Zai‑Zun and Taichung’s Da‑Qing) where urban planning, land allocation or earth‑moving delays postpone development, He said that if the delays are not the borrower’s fault, Land Bank will consider extensions based on the case’s actual situation. At the same time, the bank has strict risk‑control standards for single redevelopment zones, limiting land area to no more than 20% of the total zone to prevent excessive collateral concentration.

Looking ahead to overall housing policy, He estimated that the probability of a comprehensive easing by the central bank in the short term is low, and market liquidity will still need time to digest. Developers still seek flexibility in the 18‑month construction start rule rather than a full lift, to avoid forced starts or earth‑moving bottlenecks that could lead to unfinished projects. Land Bank will continue to uphold prudent management, balancing policy support and risk control to build a sustainable operation.

items.title: 遠東集團跨產業整合 亞泥攜手子公司打造低碳智慧建築方案
items.title_en: Far East Group Cross‑Industry Integration: Asia Cement Teams with Subsidiaries to Create Low‑Carbon Smart Building Solutions
paras: 亞泥(1102-TW)聯合旗下亞東預拌、亞利預鑄，並結合遠傳電信(4904-TW)，首次參展「2026 Build for NextGen國際永續智慧建築暨智慧建材展」，透過遠東集團跨產業整合，打造低碳智慧建築方案。
此次遠東集團展區以亞泥低碳材料為起點，串聯亞東預拌低碳混凝土、亞利預鑄工業化營造，再結合遠傳智慧建築營運方案，展現遠東集團跨產業整合能力，開展首日，遠東集團創新長徐國安出席參觀展區。
徐國安表示，「創新就是遠東精神」，面對產業與環境快速變化，集團持續整合各事業體的專業與技術，將創新轉化為實際應用，為建築產業的永續與未來發展注入新動能。
亞泥首次參與智慧建築展，以「從材料到營運」為核心，串聯旗下事業體的低碳材料、智慧製造與工程應用，亞泥持續投入製程減碳及低碳產品開發，推出「卜特蘭石灰石水泥」、「墁砌水泥」等產品，並完成所有產品類型碳足跡查證，同時通過SBTi 1.5°C減碳目標審查及CDP氣候變遷與供應商議合評比最高「A」級肯定。
亞東預拌運用低碳水泥材料，研發「LoopCon岡固低碳混凝土」，減碳幅度達30%至70%，並透過數位履歷提升品質與減碳透明度；亞利預鑄則以預鑄工法推動工廠製造、現場組裝，提升工程效率，將低碳材料延伸至營造應用。
此外，結合遠傳電信AI、AIoT、數位雙生及能源管理等技術，從材料、製造、營造一路延伸至建築營運，提升能源效率與營運效能，打造兼具未來性與永續性的智慧建築解方案。
paras_en: Asia Cement (1102‑TW) partnered with its subsidiaries Asia East Ready‑Mix and Asia Li Precast, and joined forces with Far EasTone Telecommunications (4904‑TW) to debut at the “2026 Build for NextGen International Sustainable Smart Building and Smart Materials Expo,” leveraging Far East Group’s cross‑industry integration to develop low‑carbon smart building solutions.

The Far East Group’s exhibition booth started with Asia Cement’s low‑carbon materials, linked them to Asia East Ready‑Mix’s low‑carbon concrete and Asia Li’s industrialized precast construction, and then integrated Far EasTone’s smart building operation solutions, showcasing the group’s cross‑industry capabilities. On the opening day, Far East’s innovation chief Hsu Kuo‑an attended the booth.

Hsu Kuo‑an said, “Innovation is the Far East spirit.” Facing rapid industry and environmental changes, the group continuously integrates the expertise and technology of its businesses, turning innovation into practical applications and injecting new momentum into the construction industry’s sustainability and future development.

Asia Cement’s first participation in a smart building expo centered on a “from material to operation” approach, connecting its low‑carbon materials, smart manufacturing and engineering applications. The company continues to invest in process carbon reduction and low‑carbon product development, launching products such as “Boteran limestone cement” and “Masonry cement,” completing carbon‑footprint verification for all product lines, and receiving approval for its SBTi 1.5°C reduction target as well as the highest “A” rating from CDP for climate change and supplier engagement.

Asia East Ready‑Mix uses low‑carbon cement to develop “LoopCon Kanggu Low‑Carbon Concrete,” achieving a carbon reduction of 30%‑70% and enhancing quality and carbon‑reduction transparency through digital traceability. Asia Li Precast promotes factory‑manufactured, on‑site assembled precast methods to improve construction efficiency and extend low‑carbon materials into building applications.

In addition, the solution incorporates Far EasTone’s AI, AIoT, digital twin and energy‑management technologies, extending from materials and manufacturing to construction and building operation, improving energy efficiency and operational performance to create smart building solutions that are both future‑ready and sustainable.

items.title: 友達集團智慧服務應用亮相半導體展 聚焦製造效率及能源韌性
items.title_en: AU Optronics Group Showcases Smart Service Applications at Semiconductor Expo, Focusing on Manufacturing Efficiency and Energy Resilience
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)積極推動AI四支箭布局，其中「AI產品應用與智慧服務」於SEMICON Taiwan展現成果，子公司宇沛永續聚焦半導體產業在製造效率、能源韌性與永續治理上的轉型需求，展現智慧服務如何協助企業兼顧成長與永續發展。
友達表示，隨著AI、高效能運算及先進封裝需求持續攀升，全球半導體產業迎來新一波成長浪潮，然而，在算力與產能快速擴張下，能源、水資源及碳管理挑戰也日益升高，製造效率、能源韌性及永續治理能力成為企業競爭力的關鍵分水嶺。
因應先進製程對高良率、高效率與自動化能力的需求，半導體產業普遍面臨製程穩定度、設備異常預警、產線稼動率及廠內物流效率等挑戰，宇沛永續透過智慧檢測AOI、智慧搬運AMR及智慧運營AIoT等技術，協助半導體廠串聯設備、製程與生產數據，提升製程穩定度與營運效率。
此外，AI資料中心與先進製程帶動電力需求攀升，能源管理已成為半導體產業維持產能與營運韌性的重要挑戰，宇沛永續整合智慧中樞、能源管理與ACA碳管理平台、ESCO節能服務及低碳能源布局，協助企業掌握耗能熱點、優化設備運轉並提升能源使用效率，建立高效率、高韌性的低碳營運模式。
隨著CBAM、碳揭露及供應鏈減碳要求升溫，企業面對的已不只是碳盤查，而是如何建立可持續的治理能力。宇沛永續結合氣候永續顧問、智慧水務工程、氨氮廢水回收及異味解決方案等服務，協助企業從水資源循環、環境管理到永續策略規劃，建立兼顧營運與永續的治理架構。
paras_en: Panel giant AU Optronics (2409‑TW) is actively advancing its AI “four‑arrow” strategy, with the “AI product applications and smart services” segment unveiling results at SEMICON Taiwan. Its subsidiary Yupi Sustainable focuses on the semiconductor industry's transformation needs in manufacturing efficiency, energy resilience, and sustainable governance, demonstrating how smart services can help companies balance growth with sustainability.

AU Optronics said that as demand for AI, high‑performance computing and advanced packaging continues to rise, the global semiconductor industry is entering a new wave of growth. However, rapid expansion of compute power and capacity also heightens challenges in energy, water and carbon management, making manufacturing efficiency, energy resilience and sustainable governance key competitive differentiators.

To meet advanced‑process demands for high yield, high efficiency and automation, the semiconductor sector commonly faces issues such as process stability, equipment anomaly alerts, line utilization and internal logistics efficiency. Yupi Sustainable leverages smart inspection AOI, smart transport AMR and smart operations AIoT technologies to link equipment, processes and production data, boosting process stability and operational efficiency.

Moreover, AI data centers and advanced processes drive up power demand, making energy management a critical challenge for maintaining capacity and operational resilience in the semiconductor industry. Yupi Sustainable integrates a smart hub, energy management and ACA carbon‑management platform, ESCO energy‑saving services and low‑carbon energy solutions to help firms identify energy‑hot spots, optimize equipment operation and improve energy‑use efficiency, establishing a high‑efficiency, high‑resilience low‑carbon operating model.

As CBAM, carbon disclosure and supply‑chain decarbonization requirements intensify, companies face not only carbon accounting but also the need to build sustainable governance capabilities. Yupi Sustainable combines climate‑sustainability consulting, smart water engineering, ammonia‑nitrogen wastewater recycling and odor‑control solutions to assist firms in water‑resource circulation, environmental management and sustainability strategy planning, creating a governance framework that balances operations with sustainability.

items.title: 〈台新新光法說〉台新銀上修全年NIM展望 林維俊看好台下半年景氣動能無虞
items.title_en: Taishin Shin Kong Earnings Call: Taishin Bank Raises Full-Year NIM Outlook; Lin Wei‑jun Confident About Taiwan’s H2 Economic Momentum
paras: 台新新光金控(2887-TW)今(1)日召開法說會，針對台灣下半年景氣，總經理林維俊直言，在全球 AI 算力需求爆發、相關供應鏈訂單滿載下，「下半年景氣動能應該沒有問題」，儘管仍需留意中東地緣政治風險，但管理層對營運前景信心十足，並宣布上修台新銀行全年 NIM 展望，台新與新光 2 家銀行預定於 2027 年元旦正式合併。
台新新光金控上半年稅後純益438億元，年增329%，每股稅後純益(EPS)為1.69元，年化股東權益報酬率(ROE)衝上15.36%，每股淨值為26.28元。台新銀行與新光銀行上半年合計稅後純益達172億元，年增高達74.2%。其中，台新銀行上半年稅後純益124億元(年增26%)，創下歷史同期新高記錄；新光銀行則貢獻48億元。
台新銀行上半年淨利息收入達 200 億元，年增 26.7%；淨手續費收入 110 億元，年增32%，主要受惠於財富管理與信用卡業務動能強勁。截至上半年，台新銀行總放款規模已正式突破 2 兆元大關，年增 12%。
由於資金調度與業務營運效率優於預期，台新銀行總經理林淑真表示，經營團隊已將全年的淨利息收益率(NIM)展望，由原先預期的較去年增加4至5個基點，上修至增加5至8個基點。
至於市場關注的銀行合併作業，林維俊表示，台新銀行與新光銀行已於今年8月初正式取得主管機關核准函，整體工作皆依規劃穩健推進，並取得突破性進展。未來將以台新銀行為存續公司，合併基準日確定為2027年1月1日，團隊將全力確保整併平穩順暢，發揮集團最大綜效。
全球總經方面，林維俊分析，全球景氣正處於中東衝突引發的通膨疑慮與AI歷史性投資熱潮兩股力量的拉鋸中，IMF在7月最新展望中將2026年全球經濟成長率維持在3.0%，並調升了受惠於AI投資的台、日、韓等國。
林維俊認為，全球對AI服務與算力需求強勁且供給吃緊，從台灣AI供應鏈訂單滿載現況來看，「下半年景氣動能完全沒有問題」。主要的下行風險仍為中東衝突是否會導致石油與原物料價格上升，央行利率決策與金融市場亦將隨地緣政治發展動態變化。
台新證券受惠於台股指數走高及市場交投熱絡，上半年稅後純益達75億元。隨著營運據點在合併後擴張，台新證將透過獨特的共銷機制，結合銀行與人壽通路資源，強化市場覆蓋率。面對AI產業鏈動能，也將持續優化系統以提升獲利表現。
針對資本規劃，經營團隊指出，台新證券目前資本適足率維持在300%以上的健康水準，短期內無增資需求，未來將視長遠發展考量透過聯貸等多元融資管道規劃。
paras_en: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding (2887‑TW) held an earnings conference today, and General Manager Lin Wei‑jun said that with a global explosion in AI computing demand and a fully booked supply‑chain order book, “the economic momentum for the second half of the year should not be a problem.” While noting the need to watch Middle‑East geopolitical risks, management expressed strong confidence in operating prospects and announced an upward revision of Taishin Bank’s full‑year net interest margin (NIM) outlook. The two banks, Taishin and Shin Kong, plan to formally merge on New Year’s Day 2027.

Taishin Shin Kong reported a first‑half after‑tax net profit of NT$43.8 billion, up 329% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.69. The annualized return on equity (ROE) rose to 15.36% and book value per share reached NT$26.28. Taishin Bank and Shin Kong Bank together posted a first‑half after‑tax profit of NT$17.2 billion, a 74.2% increase. Taishin Bank’s first‑half profit was NT$12.4 billion, up 26% and a historic high for the period, while Shin Kong contributed NT$4.8 billion.

Taishin Bank’s first‑half net interest income reached NT$20 billion, up 26.7% year‑over‑year, and net fee income was NT$11 billion, up 32%, driven by strong wealth‑management and credit‑card businesses. By the end of the first half, the bank’s total loan portfolio officially broke the NT$2 trillion mark, a 12% year‑over‑year increase.

Because funding deployment and operational efficiency exceeded expectations, Taishin Bank General Manager Lin Shu‑chen said the management team has revised the full‑year net interest margin (NIM) outlook from an earlier expectation of a 4‑5 basis‑point increase over last year to a 5‑8 basis‑point increase.

Regarding the much‑watched bank merger, Lin Wei‑jun said Taishin Bank and Shin Kong Bank received official approval from regulators in early August this year. The integration work is proceeding steadily as planned and has achieved breakthrough progress. The merged entity will retain Taishin Bank as the surviving company, with the merger effective date set for January 1 2027. The team will work to ensure a smooth integration and maximize group synergies.

On the global macro front, Lin Wei‑jun noted that the world economy is caught between inflation concerns sparked by Middle‑East conflicts and a historic wave of AI investment. The IMF’s July outlook kept global growth at 3.0% for 2026 and upgraded growth forecasts for AI‑benefiting economies such as Taiwan, Japan and South Korea.

Lin Wei‑jun believes that strong global demand for AI services and computing power, coupled with tight supply, means “the economic momentum for the second half is completely fine” based on Taiwan’s fully booked AI supply‑chain orders. The main downside risks remain the potential for Middle‑East tensions to push up oil and commodity prices, as well as central‑bank rate decisions and financial‑market reactions to geopolitical developments.

Taishin Securities benefited from a rising Taiwan stock index and active market trading, posting a first‑half after‑tax profit of NT$7.5 billion. After the merger, the firm will expand its operating locations and, through a unique co‑distribution mechanism that leverages bank and life‑insurance channels, enhance market coverage. Facing AI‑industry momentum, it will continue to optimize its systems to improve profitability.

Regarding capital planning, the management team said Taishin Securities’ capital adequacy ratio remains healthy at over 300%, with no short‑term capital‑raising needs. Going forward, the firm will consider diversified financing options such as syndicated loans as part of its long‑term development strategy.

items.title: 出席投資歐盟論壇 賴清德：台灣期待與歐盟簽避免雙重課稅、投資保障協定
items.title_en: President Lai Qingde Attends EU Investment Forum, Expresses Taiwan's Anticipation to Sign Double Taxation and Investment Protection Agreement with the EU
paras: 總統賴清德今(1)日出席「2026投資歐盟論壇」時表示，台灣與歐洲經貿交流日益緊密，目前台灣企業赴歐投資布局亦更具規模，面對全球產業競爭及供應鏈重組，期待台歐整合半導體領域優勢，深化戰略夥伴關係，推動簽署協定及投資保障協議，未來共同打造更安全、多元且具韌性的全球供應鏈。
賴清德今日以英文致詞時表示，這些年來，台灣與歐洲的經貿交流越來越緊密，去(2025)年台歐盟雙邊貿易額達到近750億美元，使歐盟成為台灣第5大貿易夥伴，如果以10年為單位，過去10年台企赴歐盟國家的投資額也大幅成長650%。
賴清德強調，近期很高興看到，台灣區電電公會(TEEMA)已宣布在波蘭設立科技園區，未來將有助更多台灣企業在歐盟投資並與在地產業合作，這些成果反映台歐經貿關係的深度，也顯示出台灣企業已經從單一個案投資，逐步走向更加整合、長期且深具規模的歐洲布局。
賴清德也期待，台、歐能夠在全球科技發展中，有更多的交流合作。包括明(2)日SEMICON Taiwan 2026即將登場，此項展覽可讓全球半導體與科技指標企業共同探索AI晶片、先進封裝等領域的合作商機，包括當前世界各國都致力於強化自身產業實力，歐盟執委會在今年6月公布「歐洲晶片法2.0」草案，聚焦加速晶片商業化與進入市場的時程，也展現歐洲追求半導體產業競爭力以及提升供應鏈韌性的決心。
賴清德說，目前台灣與歐洲在半導體領域各有所長，台灣已經建立高度整合的產業生態系，而歐洲在研發、設備、材料，以及高附加價值製造等領域擁有世界級的實力，透過整合台歐雙方優勢，建立半導體戰略夥伴關係，將可以創造更大的共同價值，一起打造更安全、更多元、更具韌性的全球半導體生態系。
paras_en: President Lai Qingde attended the 2026 EU Investment Forum today and said that Taiwan's economic and trade exchanges with Europe are becoming increasingly close, and that Taiwanese companies are now investing in Europe on a larger scale. Facing global industrial competition and supply‑chain restructuring, he looks forward to Taiwan and the EU integrating their strengths in the semiconductor field, deepening strategic partnership, and signing agreements and investment protection accords to jointly build a safer, more diverse and resilient global supply chain.

During his speech in English, Lai noted that over the years Taiwan’s economic and trade exchanges with Europe have grown tighter, and that by 2025 the bilateral trade volume between Taiwan and the EU will reach nearly $75 billion, making the EU Taiwan’s fifth‑largest trading partner. Over the past decade, Taiwanese investment in EU countries has grown by 650%.

Lai highlighted his pleasure at seeing the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers Association (TEEMA) announce the establishment of a technology park in Poland, which will help more Taiwanese firms invest in the EU and collaborate with local industry. These achievements reflect the depth of Taiwan‑EU economic and trade relations and show that Taiwanese companies are moving from single‑case investments to more integrated, long‑term, and large‑scale European layouts.

He also expressed hope that Taiwan and the EU can engage in more exchanges and cooperation in global technology development. Tomorrow, SEMICON Taiwan 2026 will take place, providing a platform for global semiconductor and technology leaders to explore cooperation opportunities in AI chips, advanced packaging, and more. With countries worldwide striving to strengthen their industrial capabilities, the EU Commission announced the “European Chips Act 2.0” draft in June, focusing on accelerating chip commercialization and market entry, demonstrating Europe’s determination to enhance semiconductor competitiveness and supply‑chain resilience.

Lai said that Taiwan and Europe each have strengths in the semiconductor field: Taiwan has built a highly integrated industry ecosystem, while Europe excels in R&D, equipment, materials, and high‑value manufacturing. By integrating these strengths and establishing a semiconductor strategic partnership, they can create greater shared value and jointly build a safer, more diverse, and more resilient global semiconductor ecosystem.

items.title: AI賺翻獎金卻談不攏！美光台灣工會逾八成挺罷工 晶片供應鏈拉警報
paras: 美國記憶體大廠美光(MU-US)在台工會周二(9/1)表示，除非公司改革獎金制度，並將更多獲利分享給員工，否則將朝發動罷工的方向推進。工會內部調查顯示，逾八成參與會員支持罷工，若最終付諸行動，恐衝擊美光營運及台灣半導體供應鏈。
代表美光桃園及台中員工的工會在書面回覆《路透》時表示，美光在兩地約有1.5萬名員工，其中近1萬人為工會會員。工會8月進行的內部網路調查顯示，參與投票的會員中，超過80%支持採取罷工行動。
美光台灣回應稱，今年發放的績效獎金將創公司史上最高，並表示將在尊重相關法律程序的前提下，持續透過現有管道與員工溝通。

工會要求獲利共享 一次性獎金上看83個月薪資

工會主張，美光現行激勵薪酬計畫(Incentive Pay Plan，IPP)未能充分反映公司獲利能力，因此要求2026會計年度額外發放一次性獎金。依工會提出的方案，每名台灣員工可分得的金額約相當於83個月薪資。
自2027會計年度起，工會希望廢除現行IPP制度，改為提撥營業利益的15%作為員工獎金，並由每年發放一次改為按季發放。
美光現行IPP是依據公司整體及員工個人績效決定年度獎金。工會認為，美光未充分說明公司績效指標的計算方式，且該指標似乎更貼近營收成長，而非實際獲利。工會並稱，美光已表明今年獎金仍會沿用現行制度，同時延後相關協商。
美光則表示，公司薪酬架構不同於工會要求的獲利共享模式。員工報酬除基本薪資及年度績效獎金外，也包括營運獎金、員工持股計畫及限制型股票等股權方案。
工會指出，南韓三星電子及SK海力士(SKHY-US)的獲利共享制度，已進一步拉大美光台灣員工與南韓同業員工之間的待遇差距。三星電子今年5月便在最後一刻達成協議，取消原定由最多4.8萬名工會會員參與、為期18天的罷工，並設立相當於晶片部門營業利益10.5%的特別獎金池，但仍須符合獲利目標。

台灣為美光最大生產基地 罷工恐衝擊晶片供應鏈

這項罷工威脅正值人工智慧(AI)硬體帶動記憶體需求大增之際。全球供應日益吃緊，也推升記憶體業者獲利。美光是全球第三大記憶體晶片製造商，截至5月28日止的第三季營收創下414.6億美元紀錄，淨利達282.4億美元，周二市值約1.1兆美元。
台北官員指出，台灣是美光全球最大生產基地。美光累計在台投資1.4兆元，主要生產動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)及高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，因此罷工可能對公司營運造成嚴重干擾。
中部科學園區管理局上月表示，正密切關注勞資爭議，並已指派人員協助雙方聯繫。罷工除了影響員工生計及美光營運，也可能波及台灣半導體供應鏈及整體經濟，必要時可啟動勞資協商或調解。
總統賴清德周二表示，台灣半導體產業是透過專業分工及長期合作建立，台灣始終穩定供應全球市場並信守承諾。在台灣力圖鞏固全球可靠晶片生產中心地位之際，美光勞資爭議的後續發展備受關注。

items.title: 力麗郭紹儀連任紡拓會董事長 攜手業界共創新局
items.title_en: Guo Shaoyi Re-elected Chairman of the Textile Association, Partnering with Industry to Create New Opportunities
paras: 紡拓會今(1)日召開第18屆第1次董事會，會中推選由力麗(1444-TW)暨力鵬(1447-TW)董事長郭紹儀連任紡拓會董事長，副董事長則分別由代表上游、中游及下游紡織產業之蘇百煌、黃莊芳容及吳道昌擔任。
郭紹儀表示，再次連任除了感謝全體董事的鼎力支持，也深感責任重大，面對國際經貿環境變化、綠色淨零趨勢加速，以及國際品牌對快速、彈性供應鏈的需求日益提升，均為當前紡織產業必須積極面對的重要課題。
郭紹儀強調，將進一步整合上、中、下游產業鏈的力量，積極爭取政府支持，投入更多資源，帶領紡拓會持續深耕低碳永續、加速高值化研發、拓展全球市場布局，提升地緣風險應變能力，並掌握AI發展契機，為紡織產業注入創新動能，開創更具競爭力的發展新局。
紡拓會表示，過去三年來，全球經貿環境快速變動，面對地緣政治衝突、各國關稅政策調整、生產營運成本上升及國際市場競爭加劇等多重挑戰，國內紡織產業面臨前所未有的考驗。
紡拓會指出，郭紹儀於2023年9月至2026年任期期間，帶領紡拓會穩健應對國際局勢變化，持續推動產業升級轉型，並積極協助業者開拓市場、掌握新的發展契機，在變局中持續強化產業韌性與競爭力。
paras_en: The Textile Association held its 18th first board meeting today (1), during which Chairman Guo Shaoyi of Lili (1444‑TW) and Lipei (1447‑TW) was re-elected as chairman. Vice chairmen were appointed from the upstream, midstream and downstream textile sectors: Su Baihuang, Huang Zhuangfangrong and Wu Daochang.

Guo Shaoyi expressed that his re-election is thanks to the strong support of all directors, and he feels a great responsibility. He noted that the changing international trade environment, the accelerating green zero‑emission trend, and the growing demand from international brands for fast, flexible supply chains are key challenges that the textile industry must actively confront.

He emphasized that the association will further integrate upstream, midstream and downstream industry chains, actively seek government support, invest more resources, and lead the Textile Association to continue deepening low‑carbon sustainability, accelerate high‑value R&D, expand global market presence, enhance resilience to geopolitical risks, and seize opportunities in AI development to inject innovative momentum into the textile industry and create a more competitive future.

The association stated that over the past three years, the global economic and trade environment has changed rapidly. Facing geopolitical conflicts, tariff policy adjustments, rising production and operating costs, and intensified international market competition, the domestic textile industry has encountered unprecedented challenges.

It added that during Guo Shaoyi’s term from September 2023 to 2026, he has led the association to steadily respond to international changes, continue to promote industry upgrade and transformation, and actively help operators expand markets and seize new development opportunities, thereby continuously strengthening industry resilience and competitiveness amid changing circumstances.

items.title: 央行信用管制波及！土銀土建融降至4000億 土銀董座盼「鬆綁」這件事
items.title_en: Central Bank Credit Controls Impact! Land Bank's Construction Financing Drops to 400 Billion, Chairman Hopes for 'Lifting Restrictions'
paras: 土地銀行即將迎來80週年行慶，董事長何英明受訪時表示，預估今年（2026年）獲利將延續成長態勢，順利超越去年的200億元大關，再度刷新歷史紀錄。然而，身為100%持股的國營公股銀行，土銀不以追求高每股盈餘（EPS）或支撐股價為目標，而是將超額盈餘透過特別盈餘公積轉增資、充實資本結構，並將逾期放款比率控制在0.06%左右的極低水準，以深厚儲備應對未來經濟波動及長達40年期房貸帶來的結構性挑戰。何英明指出，建商目前最期盼的並非全面鬆綁，而是希望政府能在18個月動工期限的規定上給予適度彈性。

何英明指出，商業銀行多以180天期為主的商業融資為主，收息速度較快；但土銀作為不動產專業銀行，放款期程往往長達數十年，前五年甚至可能只還息不還本，每個月收回的本金較少。因此，土銀無法採取上市銀行的經營模式，而是必須在平時累積資本盈餘，並將特別盈餘公積陸續轉為股本（目前股本已達1000多億元），避免因單一年度上繳盈餘過多而影響流動性覆蓋率（LCR）與資本適足率（BIS）。這種「求人不如求己」的深積糧策略，讓土銀在面對經濟失業率變化或金融風暴時，依然保有高度強韌的資產品質。
回顧土銀的歷史使命，何英明強調，土銀長期扮演政府政策的開路先鋒。從早期的農地改革、發行10年期實物債券與公營事業股票撫平地主，到支援台中與新竹等地的工業區開發、乃至獨力出資興建石門水庫與寶二水庫等重大水利工程，土銀肩負了遠超過一般商業銀行的社會責任與政策任務。時至今日，面對政策性新青安貸款，土銀同樣承接大量庫存案件，目前已有許多既有申請案陸續撥款，最後撥款期限預計延伸至10月底。
談及當前房市與建融現況，何英明分析，受央行信用管制及建商態度轉趨觀望、買地意願降低影響，土銀的土建融餘額已從高點約4,800億至5,000億元，逐步遞減至目前的4,000多億元。雖然建商購地趨緩，但隨著先前建案陸續完工交屋，土建融已平穩轉化為分戶房貸，使土銀的房貸業務持續維持成長力道。
針對大型重劃區（如新北溫仔圳、台中大慶等）因都市計畫、土地分配或土方處理而導致開發期程延後的個案，何英明表示，若屬不可歸責於借款人的狀況，土銀會視個案實際情形協助辦理展延。同時，土銀針對單一重劃區訂有嚴格的風險控管標準，承作土地面積通常不超過該區總面積的20%，以有效防範擔保品集中度過高的風險。
展望整體房市政策，何英明預估短期內央行政策全面放寬的機率不高，市場資金緊張仍需時間消化。建商目前最期盼的並非全面鬆綁，而是希望政府能在18個月動工期限的規定上給予適度彈性與喘息空間，避免因強迫動工或土方運送受阻而衍生爛尾樓問題。土銀未來將持續秉持穩健經營原則，兼顧政策配合與風險控管，奠定永續營運基礎。
paras_en: Land Bank is about to celebrate its 80th anniversary. Chairman He Yingming said that the bank expects to continue its growth trend this year (2026), surpassing last year’s 20 billion yuan mark and setting a new record. As a 100% state‑owned public bank, Land Bank does not chase high EPS or support its share price; instead it converts excess earnings into a special reserve and increases capital, keeping overdue loan ratios around 0.06% to prepare for future economic swings and the structural challenges of 40‑year mortgages. He added that developers are not looking for a full easing of restrictions, but rather for some flexibility in the 18‑month construction start rule.

He explained that commercial banks mainly focus on 180‑day commercial financing with quick interest collection, whereas Land Bank, as a real‑estate specialist, offers loans that can last several decades, with the first five years sometimes interest‑only, resulting in lower monthly principal repayments. Therefore, Land Bank cannot adopt the operating model of listed banks; it must accumulate capital surpluses and gradually convert the special reserve into equity (the share capital is now over 100 billion yuan) to avoid excessive annual profit contributions that would affect liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) and capital adequacy ratio (BIS). This self‑reliant, deep‑buffer strategy keeps Land Bank’s asset quality robust against unemployment shifts or financial storms.

Reflecting on its historical mission, He emphasized that Land Bank has long been a pioneer of government policy. From early land reform, issuing 10‑year physical bonds and public‑utility stocks to appease landowners, to supporting industrial zone development in Taichung and Hsinchu, and even single‑handedly funding major water projects like Shimen and Bao‑Er reservoirs, Land Bank has shouldered responsibilities far beyond a typical commercial bank. Today, facing new policy‑driven green loans, it continues to take on large inventory cases, with many existing applications already disbursed and final disbursement dates expected to extend to the end of October.

Regarding the current housing market and construction financing, He noted that due to central bank credit controls and developers’ cautious stance, Land Bank’s construction‑financing balance has fallen from a peak of about 480–500 billion yuan to just over 400 billion yuan. Although developers’ land purchases have slowed, completed projects are steadily converting construction loans into individual mortgages, allowing Land Bank’s mortgage business to maintain growth momentum.

For large redevelopment areas (such as New Taipei’s Wen‑Zai‑Zun and Taichung’s Da‑Qing) where urban planning, land allocation or earth‑moving delays postpone development, He said that if the delays are not the borrower’s fault, Land Bank will consider extensions based on the case’s actual situation. At the same time, the bank has strict risk‑control standards for single redevelopment zones, limiting land area to no more than 20% of the total zone to prevent excessive collateral concentration.

Looking ahead to overall housing policy, He estimated that the probability of a comprehensive easing by the central bank in the short term is low, and market liquidity will still need time to digest. Developers still seek flexibility in the 18‑month construction start rule rather than a full lift, to avoid forced starts or earth‑moving bottlenecks that could lead to unfinished projects. Land Bank will continue to uphold prudent management, balancing policy support and risk control to build a sustainable operation.
